title: Point-to-Plane ICP: one Gauss-Newton step
hints: Plug R ≈ I + [ω]×, t = v into rᵢ = nᵢ·(R pᵢ + t − qᵢ). Use nᵢ·(ω × pᵢ) = ω·(pᵢ × nᵢ) to get a residual that is LINEAR in δ = (ω, v).
Jacobian row: Jᵢ = [ (pᵢ × nᵢ)ᵀ , nᵢᵀ ] (1×6); residual at δ=0: rᵢ = nᵢ·(pᵢ − qᵢ).
Accumulate H = Σ JᵢᵀJᵢ (6×6) and b = Σ Jᵢᵀ rᵢ, then solve δ = −H⁻¹ b with `H.ldlt().solve(-b)`. Check degeneracy with `SelfAdjointEigenSolver<Matrix6d>` first.
applyUpdate: ΔT has rotation AngleAxis(|ω|, ω/|ω|) (identity if ω≈0) and translation v. Return ΔT * T.
